import json, sys, time, urllib.request
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
sym=sys.argv[1]
def kl(tf,n):
    d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://data-api.binance.vision/api/v3/klines?symbol=%s&interval=%s&limit=%d"%(sym,tf,n),timeout=20))
    df=pd.DataFrame(d).iloc[:,:6]; df.columns=["t","o","h","l","c","v"]
    for k in "ohlcv": df[k]=df[k].astype(float)
    return df
def ema(x,n): return pd.Series(x).ewm(span=n,adjust=False).mean().values
def tstr(ms): return time.strftime("%m-%d %H:%M",time.gmtime(ms/1000))
now=kl("1m",2); print("last 1m close",now.c.iloc[-1],"at",tstr(now.t.iloc[-1]),"UTC")
for tf,n in (("4h",300),("1h",300),("15m",300)):
    df=kl(tf,n); c=df.c.values; p=c[-1]
    e20,e50,e200=ema(c,20)[-1],ema(c,50)[-1],ema(c,200)[-1]
    pc=np.r_[c[0],c[:-1]]; tr=np.maximum(df.h.values-df.l.values,np.maximum(abs(df.h.values-pc),abs(df.l.values-pc))); atr=pd.Series(tr).ewm(alpha=1/14,adjust=False).mean().values[-1]
    print(tf,"price",p,"EMA20",round(e20,5),"EMA50",round(e50,5),"EMA200",round(e200,5),"ATR",round(atr,5),"(%.2f%%)"%(atr/p*100))
    h=df.h.values; l=df.l.values
    k={"4h":30,"1h":48,"15m":96}[tf]
    print("   last",k,"bars high",h[-k:].max(),"at",tstr(df.t.values[-k:][h[-k:].argmax()]),"| low",l[-k:].min(),"at",tstr(df.t.values[-k:][l[-k:].argmin()]))
    if tf=="1h":
        print("   last 12 1h bars (o h l c):"); 
        for i in range(-12,0): print("    ",tstr(df.t.iloc[i]),df.o.iloc[i],df.h.iloc[i],df.l.iloc[i],df.c.iloc[i])
EOF
